description: Data Set Alumbrado Público Noviembre_2017 is a series of datasets listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. ORIGEN OPERADOR FECHA MES CÓDIGO. LOCALIDAD LOCALIDAD. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Its tags are Ambiente y Desarrollo sostenible. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2019-07-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
